messages:
sam: Hey — CI started failing on the edge sample app tests (vitest). Locally everything passes. Anyone run into ESM/mock flakes here?
maya: Yup. Saw this yesterday. Feels like vitest + node ESM + mocking default exports is the culprit.
jon: What does the failure look like? stack/log paste?
sam: Failing test snippet: `TypeError: Cannot assign to read only property 'default' of function` when doing `vi.spyOn(SDK, 'createClient')` against the package's ESM entry.
maya: We're importing the SDK like `import SDK from '@redwood/inference-js'` in the app. Vitest's pre-bundling + node resolver sometimes turns that into a readonly namespace.
jon: Workaround that helped me: `import * as SDK from '@redwood/inference-js'` and then `vi.spyOn(SDK, 'createClient')`. Not great for ergonomics but avoids the read-only default issue.
sam: The annoying part: that workaround breaks a couple of TS helper types in our tests and it's only CI. Locally I can reproduce if I run `vitest node` but not with the bundled runner.
ci-bot: GitHub Actions • build #3421 failed — vitest task (edge-samples) — logs: https://ci/org/repo/job/3421
maya: I think GH Actions' node version + vitest pre-bundling (esbuild/rollup) is the variable. I had success adding `deps: { inline: ['@redwood/inference-js'] }` to vitest.config so it doesn't rewrite the module.
jon: Pasted my local vitest.config change that fixed it for me:
```ts
import { defineConfig } from 'vitest/config'
export default defineConfig({
  test: {
    environment: 'node',
    deps: {
      inline: ['@redwood/inference-js']
    },
    isolate: false
  }
})
```
sam: Nice. We also saw flaky failures around mocking `global.fetch` in edge tests — our polyfills differ between node 18 and 20 in GH actions matrix.
maya: Maybe add a small integration test that uses `vi.mock('node-fetch', ...)` in a controlled way and add matrix for node 18/20 in GH actions. Also mention in SDK README: prefer `import * as` in tests until we ship a compatible ESM/interop shim.
jon: I'll open a PR with the vitest.config change and a note in the edge sample README. Also will add a GH action job to run the sample tests on node 18 and 20 to catch this earlier.
sam: Thanks — created devex issue #402 to track SDK test guidance + CI matrix. Assigning to @jon and tagging @maya for review.
maya: 👍 will review the PR. Also maybe we should add an example test in the monorepo showing proper mocking pattern for both jest and vitest.
jon: Agreed. I'll include a tiny test and a comment about `type: 'module'` package fields and export shapes.
